name: 1-Wire temperature sensor, TO-92
in_the_bag: Loose TO-92 in an antistatic bag.
description: DS18B20 1-Wire thermometer in TO-92. −55 °C to +125 °C, ±0.5 °C from −10 °C to +85 °C. Each sensor has a 64-bit address, so more than one can share a bus. A waterproof probe is a different part, available on request. Sourced from Hall Road, Lahore.
image_note: Representative studio photograph, not a photo of the lot in the drawer.
